title: recommendation-service: elevated latency and errors
description: Customer support escalation: recommendation-service p95 latency reached 389ms (normally ~60ms) and error rate peaked at 28.1%.
root_cause_detail: Event listeners registered per request in recommendation-service v3.18.9 were never removed.
expected_symptoms: recommendation-service memory_usage climbs gradually from ~44% to ~97% over ~64+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on recommendation-service
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~60ms to ~389ms as memory grows
recommendation-service errors appear late, error rate up to ~28.1%
recommendation-service db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
deployment of recommendation-service v3.18.9 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back recommendation-service to v3.18.8 and fixed listener deregistration.
